content: If a patient does not have albuminuria or coronary artery disease (CAD), the following medication choices are recommended: 1. If initiating treatment with a single drug, select one agent from the following classes: Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEi) Angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) Calcium channel blocker (CCB) Diuretic 2. If starting treatment with dual therapy, choose two agents from two different classes among the following: ACE inhibitor (ACEi) or ARB Calcium channel blocker (CCB) Diuretic
